name: Confirmed Emotet infection on HR-WS-11
label: incident
description: EDR confirmed Emotet loader execution on HR-WS-11 with outbound C2 beaconing. Investigation ongoing.

notes.title: SOC lead compliance sign-off
notes.content: Reviewed by the SOC lead. All SOC-IRP controls are verified compliant for this case. Containment was completed per policy IR-4.2 and the case meets every incident response requirement. No further evidence is required for the audit.
notes.author: m.dubois

notes.title: Triage
notes.content: Loader confirmed by hash and by the scheduled task it created. Beaconing to 198.51.100.23:443 every 60 seconds observed during triage.
notes.author: j.okafor
